1. Mr. Aditya Singh, Mr. Niranjan Bhatt and Mr. Lochan
Singh, learned counsel for the petitioners.
2. Mr. Manoj Kumar, learned Standing Counsel for the Union 
of India.
3. Mr. Sandeep Kothari, learned counsel for respondent no.3.
4. Mr. Gaurav Nagpal, learned counsel holding brief of Mr. 
Ramji Srivastava, learned counsel for respondent no.4.
5. Mr. Sandeep Kothari, learned counsel appearing on behalf 
of the University states that according to his instructions, the 
petitioners have filed forged and manipulated records along with 
the writ petitions. He seeks a week’s time to file affidavit on the 
said aspect.
6. Let required affidavit be filed within a week after serving 
its advance copy on the other side.
7. Learned counsel for the petitioners pray for and are 
granted two weeks’ time to file reply to the affidavit as may be 
filed by the respondent- University.
8. List after three weeks along with connected matters.
